mintAuthority.summary: mHYPER has independently mintable deployments on Ethereum, Monad, Plasma, and Katana. The same EOA can mint on all four chains; Ethereum and Plasma also authorize deposit-vault proxies, and Ethereum, Monad, and Plasma authorize immutable LayerZero adapters. Chain-local transparent proxies remain upgradeable through 1-of-3 Safes and two-day Midas timelocks.

upgradeability.controlRef: Midas multichain upgrade path - chain-local 1/3 Safes through 2-day timelocks

controls.label: mHYPER deployment-wide direct-minter EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; this role can call the token mint path directly.
controls.evidence: M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE history and pinned hasRole state retained EOA 0x5683de280d0c3967fba2f04d707fa1ef5a044e25 on Ethereum block 25527148, Monad block 87587807, Plasma block 27046783, and Katana block 37244325. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode for the address on each chain.

controls.label: mHYPER Ethereum and Plasma deposit-vault minters
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; each vault holds the chain-local M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, vault proxy 0xba9fd2850965053ffab368df8aa7ed2486f11024 held M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and resolved to implementation 0xd2b5f8f1ded3d6e00965b8215b57a33c21101c63. At Plasma block 27046783, vault proxy 0xa603cf264adeb8e7f0f063c116929adac2d4286e held the same role and resolved to implementation 0x062ea1beaf82e09b44e30bc9e926af7599a603e4.

controls.label: mHYPER immutable LayerZero mint/burn adapters
controls.capDescription: The adapters hold M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and mint from authenticated LayerZero receive paths; no token supply cap was identified.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Each immutable MidasLzMintBurnOFTAdapter delegates authenticated receives to LayerZero Endpoint V2 and stores owner-configurable peer mappings.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The adapter bytecode has zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Its owner can change peers, but cannot upgrade the adapter runtime.

controls.evidence: At the pinned Ethereum, Monad, and Plasma blocks, adapters 0x148c86390a4ae6f7a02df5903bc0a89e8b4581a0, 0x08bc5ef2e2afe697614bf3a9eaa71dcbb577f2df, and 0x801c551b22dcd0a3e23ff8e6134e662e1837d75b held M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE. All three had non-proxy runtime bytecode and zero EIP-1967 proxy slots; token() returned the local mHYPER address and minterBurner() returned the adapter itself.

controls.label: Midas mHYPER multichain DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safes
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, Monad block 87587807, Plasma block 27046783, and Katana block 37244325, the chain-local MidasAccessControl granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89. Each Safe instance was 1-of-3 with the same listed EOA owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard.

controls.label: Midas mHYPER multichain DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE event histories and pinned state retained EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 on the Ethereum, Monad, Plasma, and Katana MidasAccessControl deployments. This authority can immediately grant or revoke M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on each chain.

controls.label: Midas multichain upgrade path - chain-local 1/3 Safes through 2-day timelocks

routeChecks.signingModel: Each chain-local Safe is 1-of-3 with the same three EOA owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Every current ProxyAdmin is owned by a chain-local MidasTimelockController with getMinDelay() = 172800 seconds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Safe is the sole proposer, executor, and canceller on each timelock; no DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder remains on the timelocks.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, Monad block 87587807, Plasma block 27046783, and Katana block 37244325, every transparent proxy resolved to its chain-local ProxyAdmin. ProxyAdmin owners were timelocks 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852, 0xfc8ac00c85cced29304c37727f525860039b852c, 0xe4ccb596112d35c9862d58a113342d122cfd3c2e, and 0x8d0074e92a97b2645f94e4711b08275c15998186; each returned getMinDelay() = 172800 and assigned sole proposer/executor/canceller authority to its local 1-of-3 Safe.

review.evidence: Deployment-complete audit at Ethereum block 25527148, Monad block 87587807, Plasma block 27046783, and Katana block 37244325. Current M_HYPER_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders are the shared EOA on all four chains, deposit-vault proxies on Ethereum and Plasma, and immutable Midas LayerZero adapters on Ethereum, Monad, and Plasma. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the shared EOA plus chain-local 1-of-3 Safe on every deployment. All ten mint-critical transparent proxies resolve through chain-local ProxyAdmins to two-day timelocks controlled solely by those Safes; the three LayerZero adapters are non-proxy runtimes. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: mHYPER is the first live Midas Attestation Engine feed; periodic NAV and reserve claims are notarized and published through Chainlink CRE, then independently verified onchain by LlamaRisk and Canary. The current feed documentation was reviewed 2026-07-15. FMA prospectus approval is not issuer prudential licensing. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct mint or immediate minter-administration paths are economically unbounded; existing whole-supply periodic reconciliation and independent attestation evidence remain supported.
